definition: an animal that lives in water, eaten as food

definition: small white or brown grains that you cook and eat

definition: round things from chickens that you can eat

definition: a thick white food made from milk

definition: plants you eat, e.g. carrots and onions

definition: a mix of cold vegetables, e.g. lettuce and tomatoes

definition: a sweet brown food

definition: a hot brown drink

definition: the first meal of the day

definition: the meal in the middle of the day
example: We have lunch in the school café.

definition: the meal in the evening

definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow it

definition: to take water, tea, etc. into your mouth

example_ru: Я пью два литра воды в день.

definition: to have your home in a flat

definition: to eat the first meal of the day
example: I have breakfast at seven o'clock.

definition: to look at programmes on television
example: I watch TV in the evening.

definition: to hear programmes on the radio
example: My mum listens to the radio in the car.

definition: to look at and understand the news in a newspaper
example: My grandfather reads the newspaper every morning.

definition: to eat burgers, pizzas, etc.

definition: to have tea as a drink
example: In England people drink tea with milk.

definition: to use the English language when you talk

definition: to wish to have a coffee
example: I'm tired. I want a coffee.

definition: to own a dog as a pet
example: We have a dog called Max.
example_ru: У нас есть собака по кличке Макс.

definition: to think cats are nice
example: My sister likes cats, but I don't.
example_ru: Моя сестра любит кошек, а я нет.

definition: to have a job in a bank

definition: to learn the Spanish language

definition: to attend lessons where you learn English

definition: to have to get a different car

definition: a person who works in science

definition: on some occasions, not always

definition: in most cases

definition: you say this when you don't want to eat

example_ru: Мне пиццу не надо, спасибо. Я не голоден.

definition: before the usual time
example: I get up early on weekdays.

definition: good for your body
example: Fruit is healthy food.

definition: done in the same way for a long time
example: Fish and chips is a traditional English dish.
example_ru: Рыба с картошкой — традиционное английское блюдо.

definition: that matters a lot
example: Breakfast is an important meal.

definition: not the same
example: We like different music.

definition: that you like more than all the others
example: Pizza is my favourite food.

definition: inside a small restaurant for drinks and snacks

example_ru: Мы часто встречаемся в кафе после школы.

definition: at the place where you do your job
example: My mum is at work now.

definition: hot liquid food made from vegetables or meat

definition: a type of tea popular in Asia

definition: bread made brown and hot
example: I have toast with butter for breakfast.

definition: a large amount or number of
example: She eats a lot of fruit.

definition: a person who writes books
example: J.K. Rowling is a famous writer.

definition: a company from the UK
example: I work for a British company.

definition: a journey by plane

definition: cars, buses, etc. on the road

definition: the place at an airport where you get on a plane

definition: studying at a university

example_ru: Мой брат учится в университете в Лондоне.

word: Do you want fish or pasta?

example: Do you want fish or pasta? — Pasta, please.
example_ru: Вам рыбу или пасту? — Пасту, пожалуйста.

word: I need to go to the toilet.
definition: you say this when you have to use the toilet
example: Excuse me, I need to go to the toilet.

definition: a question about the arrival time
example: What time do we arrive? — At six o'clock.
example_ru: Во сколько мы прибываем? — В шесть часов.

definition: you say this when the extra money is for the other person
example: Here's twenty pounds. Keep the change.
example_ru: Вот двадцать фунтов. Сдачи не надо.

definition: a card you need to get on a plane
example: Can I see your passport and boarding pass, please?
example_ru: Можно ваш паспорт и посадочный талон?

definition: you say this when something good happens that you didn't expect
example: Flowers for me? What a nice surprise!
example_ru: Цветы для меня? Какой приятный сюрприз!
